options.text: Schedules a cloud job that runs every 10 minutes forever
Re-runs the prompt every 10 minutes inside your current open session, sharing its context, until the session ends
Makes Claude think for 10 minutes before answering

questions.explanation: /loop is in-session polling: same session, same context, on an interval — it dies with the session. A persistent cloud job (a) is what /schedule routines are for.

questions.prompt: You want a nightly dependency-update check to run while your laptop is closed and in a bag. Which tool?

options.text: /loop 24h in a session you leave open
A Cloud Routine via /schedule — it runs in Anthropic's cloud, machine off
None — recurring AI tasks require a running machine

questions.explanation: Only the cloud tier survives your machine sleeping. /loop needs the session open; a desktop scheduled task needs the machine awake at trigger time.

questions.prompt: Which pairings of job and tool are sensible? (select all that apply)

options.text: Watch a deploy for the next 30 minutes while you keep working → /loop in your open session
Summarize new GitHub issues every morning at 9, laptop possibly off → Cloud Routine
Re-run local tests against your uncommitted working tree every hour while you're at your desk → desktop scheduled task
A permanent monitor → one /loop session you promise never to close

questions.explanation: Match distance to duration: in-session for the next hour, local schedules for local state, cloud for machine-off recurrence. An immortal /loop session (d) is a rot farm with a single point of failure: you.
